title: The Shadow Theater of Oiled Rice Paper
summary: A 45-second Canvas 2D shadow play on oiled rice paper where a traveler lends oil flame to a paper crane facing a storm dragon.
description: A 45-second looping Canvas 2D shadow theater performance on oiled rice paper. A traveler lends a flame to a paper crane as warm oil light, articulated river puppets, and a stained-scale storm dragon play across backlit shoji screens.
